imports.title: Check a listing file
imports.intro: Choose a spreadsheet export, check its columns, then review the actual problem rows.
imports.boundary: Preview only. No working records, accepted rows or public listings are created. Existing verified facts and approvals are unchanged.
imports.format: Use a UTF-8 CSV export with a header row: up to 64 KiB, 500 data rows and 32 columns. XLSX files are not supported. Formulas are displayed as text and flagged for review.
imports.mappingHint: Match each field to one source column. Reference and title are required. Unmapped fields remain unknown; nothing is inferred.
imports.limited: These are checks of the mapped text only. A clear row is not an approval, a complete listing or proof that the reference is new. No import can be applied from this preview.
imports.clean: No problems found in the mapped text. Review the source and any unmapped fields before preparing an import.
imports.failure: The file could not be checked. No rows were accepted. Choose the file again or correct the mapping.

issues.columnCount: This row has a different number of columns from the header.
issues.required: A required mapped value is missing.
issues.number: Review this number. Use digits and an optional decimal point or comma; bedrooms need a whole number.
issues.currency: Use a three-letter uppercase currency code; the code still needs human verification.
issues.url: The source URL must be HTTP or HTTPS, without credentials.
issues.formula: Formula-like source text. It has not been executed or accepted.
issues.duplicate: This exact reference appears in more than one source row. Resolve the conflict before importing.

errors.format: Choose a valid UTF-8 .csv export and map each required field to a different source column.
errors.size: The CSV exceeds 64 KiB. Split the export before checking it.
errors.rows: The CSV exceeds 500 data rows. Split the export before checking it.
errors.columns: The CSV exceeds 32 columns. Export only the needed source columns.
errors.cell: A source value exceeds 4096 characters. Review the export.
errors.quotes: The CSV has malformed quotes. Export it again with standard CSV quoting.
errors.empty: Include a header and at least one data row.

duplicates.title: Review two contacts
duplicates.intro: Compare two accessible records. A similar name or contact method does not confirm that they are the same person.
duplicates.boundary: Both records stay separate. This review cannot merge identities, move relationships or change anyone's access.
duplicates.empty: No contacts are available through your current inquiry access.
duplicates.scope: Only the contact details and inquiry links allowed by your current access are shown. Other relationships may exist and still need review.
duplicates.ownerHint: You take responsibility for this internal verification task. It is not a promise to the client.
duplicates.reviewed: I compared the visible details. Identity and affected relationships still need verification.
duplicates.saved: An internal verification task was recorded without merging the contacts or changing access. This review left identity unconfirmed.
duplicates.failure: The review could not be recorded. Check your current access and compare the current records before trying again.
duplicates.uncertain: The result is not yet confirmed. Check this same review again before starting another.

contentLocales.sourceHeld: Approve and publish the current Bulgarian source before preparing this edition.
contentLocales.stale: The Bulgarian source changed. Compare it with your draft, save a new edition and request fresh review.
contentLocales.sourceNote: The source and target are reviewed separately. Language approval does not approve claims or publish content.
contentLocales.manual: Write or paste the target text. The Bulgarian text is shown above for comparison. Saving creates a private draft.
contentLocales.claims: Record qualified review of this edition
contentLocales.preview: Private preview of this language edition
contentLocales.sameHuman: Each decision records the person and capability used. One person may make separate decisions when authorized.
contentLocales.noApprovals: No human decision has been recorded for this revision.
contentLocales.next: Open this language edition to check its current review state and next permitted action.
contentLocales.conflict: The source or edition changed. Your text is retained. Compare the current edition and reopen it before reviewing again.

importExecution.boundary: Check the file without changing business records. After a separate review, selected rows can create or update supplied working drafts. Facts, availability and publication still need their normal human review.
importExecution.intro: Check the source and mapping, review an exact subset, then follow its durable result.
importExecution.limited: Text checks are the first step. Prepare a dry run to compare these rows with current records before selecting any changes.
importExecution.setupHint: These declarations apply to this file. Country, region, property type and purpose are used for new records only. Location must be an exact settlement in the mapped source. Prices use EUR, areas use m² and the chosen basis; bedrooms may be zero. Blank cells preserve existing values. No currency conversion is performed.
importExecution.subset: Only checked rows will be accepted. Each changed field needs an explicit choice. This review does not execute the import.
importExecution.confirm: I reviewed the selected rows, their source, interpretation and every changed field.
importExecution.executeHint: Each row commits separately. Continue with this same receipt to process pending reviewed rows. An interrupted request may have committed some rows; check this receipt before retrying.
importExecution.stopConfirm: I understand that stopping does not reverse committed rows.
importExecution.reverseConfirm: I reviewed the committed rows below. Reverse only drafts that have not changed since import.
importExecution.reverseHint: A reversal restores an unchanged earlier working draft. A newly created draft is emptied and withdrawn while its identity and source history remain. Later edits, revisions or dependent records can block reversal. Up to 10 rows are checked per request.
importExecution.failed: The command could not finish. Current results are shown below. Review changed source, choices, revisions and access before continuing.
importExecution.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Use this same receipt to reconcile it before starting another import.

issues.reference_format: Keep the exact MS listing reference: MS- followed by at least five digits, within the supported reference range.
issues.target_unavailable: This reference cannot be imported with your current record access.
issues.draft_manual: The existing record needs its normal inventory source review before a CSV draft update is supported.
issues.location_manual: The source settlement differs from the current record. Review this protected location through the normal inventory workflow.
issues.purpose_manual: The declared source purpose differs from this listing. Review the sale/rent price meaning through the normal inventory workflow.
issues.location_required: A new record needs an exact mapped settlement, up to 150 characters.
issues.price_eur_positive: A supplied price must be positive and explicitly in EUR. Other source currencies remain in the evidence for manual review.
issues.area_positive: A supplied area must be positive.
issues.draft_limits: The proposed working draft exceeds an editor limit or has unsupported source details.
issues.version_conflict: The reviewed record or source changed. Prepare a fresh dry run.
issues.target_changed: A later record change prevents automatic reversal.
issues.dependent_records: A later relationship or record depends on this identity. Review it manually before reversal.

contentBody.hint: Choose the structure to save. All text, steps and links need the same human review as the page. No HTML or media embeds.
contentBody.heading: Subheading
contentBody.title: Step or callout title
contentBody.itemsHint: One item per line, in reading order.
contentBody.hrefHint: Use a path to a public page, for example /bg/contact. Private pages, files and external URLs are not supported.
contentBody.native: Open an unused block to add content. Saving a draft does not approve it.
contentBody.invalid: Review the block type, required text and public page path.
